{{Quote|The Jedi faced me and identified himself as Kindro Nimmel. He said he'd been sent to Longwind to monitor the settlers and that he'd been on patrol when he saw my father, and that my father had attacked him and broken his arm.|Cradossk, ''Making a Killing''|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Kindro Nimmel''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. At some pint during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Nimmel was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Longwind]] to monitor the activities of the residents of a former [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] settlement on the world. While on patrol, he was attacked by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Agnuk]], who broke the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Limb/Legends|arm]], though Nimmel ultimately succeeded at [[Death/Legends|killing]] his assailant. Moments later, Agnuk's son [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] stumbled across his father's corpse and in a rage, he sprang on Nimmel and broke his legs, then sank his teeth into the Jedi's neck and murdered him. Cradossk later wrote about his encounter with Nimmel in his autobiography ''[[Making a Killing]]''.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />
